description: This source file provides utility methods for setting up and managing test data related to books in the context of statistics testing within the Book Project. It includes functions to create mock books, populate the dataset with specific test cases, and retrieve statistical information about the books read.

classes.name: StatisticTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class for creating, managing, and retrieving statistical test data related to books in the project, mainly used for testing purposes.

methods.name: populateReadBooks
methods.description: Initializes the dataset with predefined books representing various ratings, genres, and reading dates for testing statistical calculations.

methods.name: addReadBook
methods.description: Creates and adds a sample read book record to the dataset for testing.

methods.name: getBookWithLowestRating
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating in the dataset.

methods.name: getBookWithHighestRating
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating in the dataset.

methods.name: getBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns the book with the most pages.

methods.name: getBookWithLowestRatingThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating that was read this year.

methods.name: getBookWithHighestRatingThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating that was read this year.

methods.name: getNumberOfBooks
methods.description: Returns the total number of books in the dataset.

methods.name: getNumberOfBooksThisYear
methods.description: Returns the number of books read in the current year.

methods.name: getTotalNumberOfPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total pages of all books in the dataset.

methods.name: deleteBook
methods.description: Removes a book from the dataset and updates ratings accordingly.
